<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_gmg_ai.ActionService</api_name><caller_access /><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Confirm/reject pending actions; applies via global.GMGAIApplier</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ActionService</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>// Copyright 2026 GMG Technology LLC
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
var ActionService = Class.create();
/* Open-core split step 5: paid kinds, the Reviewer verdict, run_as lock, build rules and takeovers come from GMGExtensions
 * (GMG Plan & Create). Open source alone confirms only core kinds ('record', artifact update); anything else is 409 "needs GMG Plan & Create". */
ActionService.ext = function(hook, args) { return typeof GMGExtensions == 'undefined' ? [] : GMGExtensions.call(hook, args); };
ActionService.paidInstalled = function() { return typeof GMGExtensions != 'undefined' && GMGExtensions.installed(); };
ActionService.takeoverOk = function(pa) { return ActionService.ext('canActOn', [pa]).some(function(r) { return r === true; }); };   // paid: R2b.10a/d takeover admin
/* Confirm / reject pending actions. Validates: same user, still pending, not expired. Applies core kinds via global.GMGAIApplier, paid kinds via their handler. */
ActionService.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    _load: function(id) {
        var pa = new GlideRecord('x_gmg_ai_pending_action');
        if (!id || !(typeof ReviewWriteGuard == 'undefined' ? pa.get(id) : ReviewWriteGuard.serverGet(pa, id))) return {error: 'Pending action not found.', code: 404};
        if (pa.getValue('user') != gs.getUserID() && gs.hasRole('admin') !== true && !ActionService.takeoverOk(pa)) return   /* (C) an admin may Accept any card; user stays the card's owner */ {error: 'This action belongs to another user.', code: 403};
        if (pa.getValue('status') != 'pending') return {error: 'Action is already ' + pa.getValue('status') + '.', code: 409};
        var exp = new GlideDateTime(pa.getValue('expires'));
        if (new GlideDateTime().after(exp)) {
            pa.setValue('status', 'expired'); ActionService.srvUpdate(pa);
            return {error: 'Action expired (30 minute limit). Ask the agent to propose it again.', code: 410};
        }
        return {pa: pa};
    },

    reject: function(id) {
        var r = this._load(id);
        if (r.error) return r;
        r.pa.setValue('status', 'rejected');
        r.pa.setValue('decided_at', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
        ActionService.srvUpdate(r.pa);
        this._log(r.pa, 'rejected', 'Rejected by user');
        if (typeof DiagnosticService != 'undefined') {
            DiagnosticService.logAuditEvent({
                eventType: DiagnosticService.EVENT_TYPES.APPROVAL_REJECTED,
                targetTable: r.pa.getValue('target_table'),
                targetSysId: r.pa.getValue('target_sys_id'),
                outcome: 'rejected',
                details: 'Proposal rejected by user ' + gs.getUserName()
            });
        }
        return {ok: true, status: 'rejected'};
    },

    confirm: function(id, runAs, opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        var r = this._load(id);   // 404 / 403 (requester-only) / 409 / 410 expired, before any role check
        if (r.error) return r;
        var pa = r.pa;
        var wo = ActionService.writesOff(); if (wo) return this._refuse(pa, {reason: wo});   // read-only for non-admins, also for cards made before the switch
        var nb = ActionService.notPassedBlock(pa); if (nb) return nb;   // core seal (route none) / review needs paid (route reviewer), before any write
        var kp = null; try { kp = JSON.parse(pa.getValue('payload')); } catch (e0) {}
        if (kp && !ActionService.isCoreKind(ActionService.kindOf(kp), kp) && !ActionService.handlerFor(ActionService.kindOf(kp), kp)) return ActionService.needsPaid(pa);   // license lapse / paid absent: 409, nothing written
        if (kp && ActionService.isCoreKind(ActionService.kindOf(kp), kp)) {   // step 7: core kinds only for the record they were bound to (stored binding; the live page is not re-checked)
            var bc = ActionService.boundCheck({target_table: pa.getValue('target_table'), target_sys_id: pa.getValue('target_sys_id'), bound_table: pa.isValidField('bound_table') ? pa.getValue('bound_table') : '', bound_sys_id: pa.isValidField('bound_sys_id') ? pa.getValue('bound_sys_id') : ''}, kp);
            if (bc) return {ok: false, code: 409, not_bound: true, error: bc};
            var dn = ActionService.deniedAtConfirm(pa.getValue('target_table'));   // step 9: floor / property / ACL-role elevation re-checked at Confirm (409 if dropped), before anything is written
            if (dn) return {ok: false, code: 409, not_elevated: ActionService.ACL_ROLE_TABLES.indexOf(String(pa.getValue('target_table'))) >= 0, denied: true, error: dn};
        }
        if (kp && kp.bound && !kp.kind && kp.op == 'update') { var sc = this._activeRecheck(pa, kp); if (sc) return sc; }   // step 8
        /* paid beforeConfirm: Reviewer verdict, run_as lock (flow cards), card options of paid kinds, build-item update set rule. A throw = block. */
        var blk = typeof GMGExtensions == 'undefined' ? null : GMGExtensions.blocked('beforeConfirm', [pa, {run_as: runAs, opts: opts}]);
        if (blk) return blk;
        /* role map, then ACL (GlideRecordSecure), for the CONFIRMER (session user). Runs after the card
         * options above so run_as cannot be swapped after the check. A refusal never reaches the Applier. */
        var payload = null;
        try { payload = JSON.parse(pa.getValue('payload')); } catch (e4) {}
        var auth = this._authorize(pa, payload);
        if (!auth.ok) return this._refuse(pa, auth);
        pa.setValue('status', 'approved');
        pa.setValue('decided_at', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
        if (pa.isValidField('confirmed_by')) pa.setValue('confirmed_by', gs.getUserID());
        ActionService.srvUpdate(pa);

        if (typeof DiagnosticService != 'undefined') {
            DiagnosticService.logAuditEvent({
                eventType: DiagnosticService.EVENT_TYPES.APPROVAL_ACCEPTED,
                targetTable: pa.getValue('target_table'),
                targetSysId: pa.getValue('target_sys_id'),
                outcome: 'accepted',
                details: 'Proposal confirmed by user ' + gs.getUserName()
            });
        }
        var res;
        /* step 5 part 2: core kinds apply through the core facade global.GMGAIApplier; a paid kind through its registered handler's apply. */
        var hk = kp && !ActionService.isCoreKind(ActionService.kindOf(kp), kp) ? ActionService.handlerFor(ActionService.kindOf(kp), kp) : null;
        try { res = hk && typeof hk.apply == 'function' ? hk.apply(id) : new global.GMGAIApplier().apply(id); } catch (e) { res = {ok: false, error: 'Apply threw: ' + e}; }
        pa = new GlideRecord('x_gmg_ai_pending_action'); (typeof ReviewWriteGuard == 'undefined' ? pa.get(id) : ReviewWriteGuard.serverGet(pa, id));
        if (!res.ok && res.not_public) return this._refuse(pa, {reason: res.not_public_reason || res.error || 'This flow uses actions that are not public.'});   // backstop: refused, not failed (reason from the paid applier)
        pa.setValue('status', res.ok ? 'applied' : 'failed');
        pa.setValue('result', JSON.stringify(res).substring(0, 4000));
        if (res.update_set_id) pa.setValue('update_set', res.update_set_id);
        if (res.sys_id) pa.setValue('target_sys_id', res.sys_id);
        ActionService.srvUpdate(pa);   // server path: status / update_set are server-only (ReviewWriteGuard)
        if (res.ok) { var aa = ActionService.ext('afterApply', [pa, res]); if (aa.length) res.build_item = aa[0]; }   // paid: build-item afterApply (a throw is logged and skipped)
        var prl = res.pref_line ? '\n' + res.pref_line : '';   // PREFRESTORE AC3: before/after of the 4 prefs
        this._log(pa, res.pref_restore && (!res.pref_restore.ok || (res.pref_restore.unrestorable && res.pref_restore.unrestorable.length)) ? 'error' : (res.ok ? 'applied' : 'failed'), (res.ok ? ('Applied ' + pa.getValue('operation') + ' ' + pa.getValue('target_table') + ' ' + res.sys_id +
            (res.update_set_name ? ' in update set "' + res.update_set_name + '"' : (res.data_write ? ' as a data write (no update set)' : ' (no update set)')) + ' ' + res.link) : res.error) + prl);   // a data write has no update set (was "undefined"); same rule as the panel's applied line
        if (typeof DiagnosticService != 'undefined') {
            DiagnosticService.logAuditEvent({
                eventType: res.ok ? DiagnosticService.EVENT_TYPES.CHANGE_APPLIED : DiagnosticService.EVENT_TYPES.CHANGE_REJECTED,
                targetTable: pa.getValue('target_table'),
                targetSysId: res.sys_id || pa.getValue('target_sys_id'),
                outcome: res.ok ? 'applied' : 'failed',
                errorCode: res.ok ? null : 'RECORD_ACCESS_ERROR',
                details: res.ok ? ('Applied ' + pa.getValue('operation') + ' to ' + pa.getValue('target_table')) : res.error
            });
        }
        res.status = res.ok ? 'applied' : 'failed';
        return res;
    },

    /* Refusal: status 'refused', HTTP 403, logged; the Applier is never called, so no update set and no record. */
    _refuse: function(pa, auth) {
        pa.setValue('status', 'refused');
        pa.setValue('decided_at', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
        if (pa.isValidField('confirmed_by')) pa.setValue('confirmed_by', gs.getUserID());
        var out = ActionService.refusalBody(auth);
        pa.setValue('result', JSON.stringify(out).substring(0, 4000));
        ActionService.srvUpdate(pa);
        this._log(pa, 'refused', 'Refused at Accept: ' + auth.reason);
        out.code = 403;
        return out;
    },

    /* Single decision point for Confirm-time authorization. Returns {ok:true} or {ok:false, reason, required_roles}. */
    _authorize: function(pa, p) {
        if (!p) return {ok: false, reason: 'Proposal payload is unreadable.'};
        var key = ActionService.kindOf(p);
        if (key == 'record' && !p.sys_id) p.sys_id = pa.getValue('target_sys_id');
        var roles = ActionService.rolesFor(key, p);
        if (!roles) return {ok: false, reason: 'Unknown change type "' + key + '"; refused.'};
        if (roles.length && !ActionService.hasAnyRole(roles, function(r) { return gs.hasRole(r); }))
            return {ok: false, required_roles: roles, reason: 'You do not have permission to accept this change (' + key + '). Requires one of the roles: ' + roles.join(', ') + '.'};
        var acl = this._aclCheck(key, p);
        if (!acl.ok) return {ok: false, required_roles: roles, reason: 'Access denied by ACL: ' + acl.reason, unknown_fields: acl.unknown_fields, not_allowed_fields: acl.not_allowed_fields};
        var h = ActionService.handlerFor(key, p);   // paid handler pre-check after role map + ACL (flow public check); before status=approved
        if (h && typeof h.precheck == 'function') { var pc = h.precheck(p, pa); if (pc && !pc.ok) { gs.info('GMG AI: handler pre-check refused ' + pa.getUniqueValue()); return {ok: false, required_roles: roles, reason: pc.error}; } }
        return {ok: true, key: key, required_roles: roles};
    },

    /* GlideRecordSecure gate on the target: canWrite() for an existing record, canCreate() for a new one. */
    _aclCheck: function(key, p) {
        var t = ActionService.aclTarget(key, p);
        if (!t) return {ok: true};
        var ops = ActionService.aclOps(key, p, t);
        if (ops && typeof global.GMGAIApplier.userAccess == 'function') return global.GMGAIApplier.userAccess(ops);   // ACL fix: user ACLs checked in global scope (see GMGAIApplier.userAccess)
        var g;
        try { g = new GlideRecordSecure(t.table); } catch (e) { return {ok: false, reason: 'cannot open table ' + t.table}; }
        if (!g.isValid()) return {ok: false, reason: 'invalid table ' + t.table};
        if (t.sys_id) {
            if (!g.get(t.sys_id)) return {ok: false, reason: 'target ' + t.table + ' ' + t.sys_id + ' not found or not readable'};
            if (!g.canWrite()) return {ok: false, reason: 'no write access to ' + t.table + ' ' + t.sys_id};
            return ActionService.fieldsCheck(g, ActionService.payloadFields(key, p), t, new GlideRecord(t.table));   // every payload field: valid + field ACL
        }
        g.initialize();
        return g.canCreate() ? {ok: true} : {ok: false, reason: 'no create access on ' + t.table};
    },

    /* step 8 (spec 5): re-read 'active' on a bound artifact edit. Changed since propose (either way) -> nothing applied; the card is updated
     * (payload.active_at_propose, warning line), re-sealed server-side, kept pending, and returned for the user to confirm again (409 state_changed). */
    _activeRecheck: function(pa, kp) {
        var g = new GlideRecord(String(kp.table || '')); if (!g.isValid() || !g.get(String(kp.sys_id || ''))) return null;   // missing: the Applier refuses
        var now = !g.isValidField('active') ? '' : (String(g.getValue('active')) == '1' || String(g.getValue('active')) == 'true' ? 'true' : 'false');
        if (String(kp.active_at_propose || '') == now) return null;
        var note = ActionService.ACTIVE_NOTE[now] || '';
        kp.active_at_propose = now; pa.setValue('payload', JSON.stringify(kp));
        var d = String(pa.getValue('diff') || '').split('\n').filter(function(l) { return l.indexOf(ActionService.ACTIVE_NOTE['true']) < 0 && l.indexOf(ActionService.ACTIVE_NOTE['false']) < 0; });
        if (note) d.push('NOTE: ' + note); pa.setValue('diff', d.join('\n'));
        if (typeof GMGSeal != 'undefined') GMGSeal.sealRouteNone(pa);   // server re-seal of the server's own change
        ActionService.srvUpdate(pa);
        if (typeof GMGSeal != 'undefined') GMGSeal.storeSeal(pa);   // new server seal for the re-sealed card (the newest seal counts)
        this._log(pa, 'pending', 'Confirm skipped: active changed to ' + now + ' since the proposal');
        return {ok: false, code: 409, state_changed: true, status: 'pending', active: now, live_warning: now == 'true' ? note : '', data_warning: note, error: ActionService.STATE_CHANGED, diff: d};
    },

    _log: function(pa, status, text) {
        try {
            var l = new GlideRecord('x_gmg_ai_log');
            l.initialize();
            l.setValue('user', gs.getUserID());
            if (l.isValidField('confirmed_by') && status != 'rejected') l.setValue('confirmed_by', gs.getUserID());
            l.setValue('page_url', pa.getValue('page_url'));
            if (l.isValidField('conversation_id') && pa.isValidField('conversation_id')) l.setValue('conversation_id', pa.getValue('conversation_id') || '');
            l.setValue('table_name', pa.getValue('target_table'));
            l.setValue('record_sys_id', pa.getValue('target_sys_id'));
            l.setValue('tools', 'action:' + pa.getValue('action_type') + ':' + pa.getValue('operation'));
            
            var cleanSummary = (typeof DiagnosticService != 'undefined') ? DiagnosticService.redact(pa.getValue('summary')) : pa.getValue('summary');
            l.setValue('prompt', ('Pending action ' + pa.getUniqueValue() + ': ' + cleanSummary).substring(0, 4000));
            
            var cleanText = (typeof DiagnosticService != 'undefined') ? DiagnosticService.redact(String(text)) : String(text);
            l.setValue('response', cleanText.substring(0, 4000));
            l.setValue('status', status);
            l.setValue('pending_action', pa.getUniqueValue());
            l.insert();
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof gs != 'undefined' && gs.error) gs.error('GMG AI action log failed: ' + e);
        }
    },

    type: 'ActionService'
};

/* ---- role map (pure; unit-tested in test/test_action_roles.js). admin always passes gs.hasRole. ---- */
/* Rulings (1)-(3): a Reviewer-routed proposal is applied only after a stored pass on the payload the Reviewer read; a proposal marked
 * review_route 'none' at creation is not reviewed; anything else (empty / unknown route) is refused. 409 before any write. */
/* route-none seal mismatch at Accept: 409 before any write. An old-canon seal that still matches = out of date (design review wording), else edited. */
ActionService.notPassedBlock = function(pa) {   // core seal gate (GMGSeal.routeGate), checked BEFORE any write; the global Applier repeats GMGAIApplier.reviewGateOf
    var why = typeof GMGSeal == 'undefined' ? 'Review gate unavailable.' : GMGSeal.routeGate(GMGSeal.gateInput(pa), ActionService.paidInstalled());
    if (!why) why = GMGSeal.serverSealGate(pa);   // the row's hash must also equal the server-only seal (x_gmg_ai_log), so a rewritten payload + hash is refused
    return why ? {ok: false, code: 409, not_passed: true, out_of_date: typeof GMGSeal != 'undefined' && why == GMGSeal.REVIEW_GATE.stale, error: why} : null;
};
/* x_gmg_ai.allow_non_admin_writes = false makes the agent read-only for non-admins (admin = the admin role; the free
 * tier has no x_gmg_ai.admin role). Missing or anything but the text 'false' = true (unchanged). Shared by AgentCore (tools + prompt),
 * RecordTools.propose (proposal) and ActionService.confirm (Accept). Returns '' (writes allowed) or the refusal text. */
ActionService.WRITE_PROP = 'x_gmg_ai.allow_non_admin_writes';
ActionService.WRITES_OFF = 'Updating records is turned off for your role. I can still read and explain this record for you.';
ActionService.writesOffFor = function(prop, isAdmin) {
    if (isAdmin === true) return '';
    return String(prop === null || prop === undefined ? '' : prop).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '').toLowerCase() == 'false' ? ActionService.WRITES_OFF : '';
};
ActionService.writesOff = function() { return ActionService.writesOffFor(gs.getProperty(ActionService.WRITE_PROP, 'true'), gs.hasRole('admin') === true); };
/* Panel access (admin setting x_gmg_ai.panel_access): everyone (default) | admins | off. admins = the admin role, decided like
 * allow_non_admin_writes (gs.hasRole('admin')). Missing, empty or any other value = everyone. Enforced server-side by the chat, action
 * (Confirm/Reject) and health REST operations; the panel only hides its launcher from the same answer (GET /health?access=1).
 * Returns '' (allowed) or the refusal text. */
ActionService.PANEL_PROP = 'x_gmg_ai.panel_access';
ActionService.PANEL_OFF = 'Now Pilot is turned off for your role.';
ActionService.panelModeOf = function(prop) {
    var v = String(prop === null || prop === undefined ? '' : prop).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '').toLowerCase();
    return v == 'admins' || v == 'off' ? v : 'everyone';
};
ActionService.panelOffFor = function(prop, isAdmin) {
    var m = ActionService.panelModeOf(prop);
    if (m == 'off') return ActionService.PANEL_OFF;
    if (m == 'admins' && isAdmin !== true) return ActionService.PANEL_OFF;
    return '';
};
ActionService.panelOff = function() { return ActionService.panelOffFor(gs.getProperty(ActionService.PANEL_PROP, 'everyone'), gs.hasRole('admin') === true); };
ActionService.NOT_BOUND = 'This change is not for the record it was proposed on.';

ContextStore.CONV_ACLS = [   // [table, operation, script ('' = none), role, advanced]; must equal build.py ctx_security (test_install_gate.js)

ContextStore.COMPACT_MAX_IDS = 200;   // review fix: identifiers kept per compacted result
ContextStore.DEFAULT_WINDOW = 32000;
ContextStore.HISTORY_TOKENS = 12000;     // fixed history cap (property x_gmg_ai.context.history_tokens, 4000-32000)
ContextStore.HISTORY_MIN = 4000; ContextStore.HISTORY_MAX = 32000;    // conservative when the model is unknown
/* Per-model context windows (tokens). UPDATE THIS TABLE WHEN NEW MODELS ARE ADDED; unmatched models get DEFAULT_WINDOW. */

/* ---------- pure helpers (unit-tested in test/test_context.js, no Glide) ---------- */

/* Window order: property x_gmg_ai.context.window_tokens if set and > 0, then the per-model table (ContextStore.WINDOWS), then DEFAULT_WINDOW.

        (String(m.result || '') + ' ' + String(m.args || '')).replace(/\b[0-9a-f]{32}\b/g, function(x) { if (!ids[x] && il.length < 30) { ids[x] = 1; il.push(x); } return x; });
    });
    return (tl.length ? 'tools: ' + tl.join(', ') : '') + (il.length ? (tl.length ? ' | ' : '') + 'sys_ids: ' + il.join(', ') : '');
};
/* summary text for folded rows: model text (if given) + row-built ids, else the row-built lines */
ContextStore.foldText = function(foldedRows, modelText) {
    var rowLines = ContextStore.turns(foldedRows).map(ContextStore.summarizeTurn).join('\n');
    if (!modelText) return {text: rowLines, source: 'rows'};
    var ids = ContextStore.idsOf(foldedRows);
    return {text: String(modelText).substring(0, 3000) + (ids ? '\n  [' + ids + ']' : ''), source: 'model'};
};
ContextStore.summarizeTurn = function(turn) {
    var q = '', a = '', tools = [];
    turn.forEach(function(m) {
        if (m.role == 'user') q = String(m.text || '').substring(0, 200);
        else if (m.role == 'tool') tools.push(m.tool_name + (/\b[0-9a-f]{32}\b/.test(m.result || '') ? ' (' + ((m.result.match(/\b[0-9a-f]{32}\b/g) || []).slice(0, 3).join(', ')) + ')' : ''));
        else if (m.text) a = String(m.text).substring(0, 240);
    });
    return '- User: ' + q + (tools.length ? ' | tools: ' + tools.join('; ') : '') + (a ? ' | Agent: ' + a : '');
};
/* Normalized adapter messages from rows (agent rows with args = tool_calls JSON; tool rows answer them). */
ContextStore.toAdapter = function(rows) {
    var out = [];
    rows.forEach(function(m) {
        if (m.role == 'user') out.push({role: 'user', content: String(m.text || '')});
        else if (m.role == 'agent') {
            var o = {role: 'assistant', content: String(m.text || '')}, tc = null;
            try { tc = m.args ? JSON.parse(m.args) : null; } catch (e) {}
            if (tc && tc.length) o.tool_calls = tc;
            if (o.content || o.tool_calls) out.push(o);
        } else if (m.role == 'tool') out.push({role: 'tool', tool_call_id: m.tool_call_id, name: m.tool_name, content: m.compacted ? ContextStore.compact(m.tool_name, m.result) : String(m.result || '')});
    });
    // a tool result whose tool_calls message was dropped would be rejected by the providers: drop orphans
    var calls = {};
    out.forEach(function(m) { (m.tool_calls || []).forEach(function(c) { calls[c.id] = 1; }); });
    return out.filter(function(m) { return m.role != 'tool' || calls[m.tool_call_id]; });
};
/* Newest-first fill of whatever still fits (whole turns only, so tool pairs stay intact). */
ContextStore.fit = function(rows, budget) {
    var turns = ContextStore.turns(rows), keep = [], used = 0;
    for (var i = turns.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        var t = 0; turns[i].forEach(function(m) { t += ContextStore.msgTokens(m); });
        if (used + t > budget && keep.length) break;
        keep = turns[i].concat(keep); used += t;
    }
    return {rows: keep, tokens: used, dropped_turns: turns.length - ContextStore.turns(keep).length};
};

/* Chat retention: a setting, never more than 5 days. Above 5 = 5; missing, not a whole number, 0 or negative = 5. */
ContextStore.RETENTION_PROP = 'x_gmg_ai.context.retention_days';
ContextStore.RETENTION_MAX = 5;
ContextStore.retentionDays = function(raw) {
    var t = String(raw === null || raw === undefined ? '' : raw).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
    if (!/^-?\d+$/.test(t)) return ContextStore.RETENTION_MAX;
    var d = parseInt(t, 10);
    if (!(d > 0)) return ContextStore.RETENTION_MAX;
    return d > ContextStore.RETENTION_MAX ? ContextStore.RETENTION_MAX : d;
};

/* ---------- Glide side ---------- */
ContextStore.prototype = {
    initialize: function() { this.T_CONV = 'x_gmg_ai_conversation'; this.T_MSG = 'x_gmg_ai_message'; },

    /* get-or-create the caller's conversation by the panel's conversation id. Another user's key never matches (user is part of the query). */
    open: function(key, ctx) {
        key = String(key || '');
        if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,64}$/.test(key)) return null;
        var c = new GlideRecord(this.T_CONV);
        c.addQuery('user', gs.getUserID()); c.addQuery('conversation_key', key); c.setLimit(1); c.query();
        if (!c.next()) {
            c = new GlideRecord(this.T_CONV); c.initialize();
            c.setValue('user', gs.getUserID()); c.setValue('conversation_key', key); c.setValue('billed_tokens', 0); c.setValue('message_count', 0);
            c.setValue('summary', ''); c.setValue('summarized_through', 0);
        }
        c.setValue('page_url', String((ctx || {}).url || '').substring(0, 1000));
        c.setValue('page_context', JSON.stringify(this._pageCtx(ctx)).substring(0, 4000));
        c.setValue('last_activity', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
        if (c.isNewRecord()) c.insert(); else c.update();
        return c;
    },
    _pageCtx: function(ctx) {
        ctx = ctx || {}; var o = {};
        ['url', 'ui', 'kind', 'table', 'sys_id', 'view', 'query'].forEach(function(k) { if (ctx[k]) o[k] = String(ctx[k]).substring(0, 500); });
        if (ctx.fields) o.field_names = Object.keys(ctx.fields).slice(0, 40);
        return o;
    },
    /* write one row as it happens; returns {sys_id, seq, tokens} */
    append: function(conv, role, f) {
        f = f || {};
        var seq = (parseInt(conv.getValue('message_count'), 10) || 0) + 1, m = new GlideRecord(this.T_MSG);
        m.initialize();
        m.setValue('conversation', conv.getUniqueValue()); m.setValue('seq', seq); m.setValue('role', role);
        if (f.text) m.setValue('text', String(f.text));
        if (f.tool_name) m.setValue('tool_name', f.tool_name);
        if (f.tool_call_id) m.setValue('tool_call_id', f.tool_call_id);
        if (f.args) m.setValue('args', typeof f.args == 'string' ? f.args : JSON.stringify(f.args));
        if (f.result !== undefined) m.setValue('result', typeof f.result == 'string' ? f.result : JSON.stringify(f.result));
        var tok = f.tokens || ContextStore.msgTokens({role: role, text: f.text, args: m.getValue('args'), result: m.getValue('result'), tool_name: f.tool_name});
        m.setValue('est_tokens', tok); if (f.estimated) m.setValue('estimated', true);
        var id = m.insert();
        conv.setValue('message_count', seq);
        conv.setValue('last_activity', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
        conv.update();
        return {sys_id: id, seq: seq, tokens: tok};
    },
    /* billed_tokens = billed input + output of every model call (estimated only when the provider returned no usage; that agent row is flagged estimated) */
    addTokens: function(conv, n) { if (!n) return; conv.setValue('billed_tokens', (parseInt(conv.getValue('billed_tokens'), 10) || 0) + n); conv.update(); },
    rows: function(conv) {
        var out = [], m = new GlideRecord(this.T_MSG);
        m.addQuery('conversation', conv.getUniqueValue()); m.addQuery('folded', false); m.orderBy('seq'); m.query();
        while (m.next()) out.push({sys_id: m.getUniqueValue(), seq: parseInt(m.getValue('seq'), 10), role: m.getValue('role'), text: m.getValue('text') || '',
            tool_name: m.getValue('tool_name') || '', tool_call_id: m.getValue('tool_call_id') || '', args: m.getValue('args') || '', result: m.getValue('result') || '',
            compacted: m.getValue('compacted') == '1'});
        return out;
    },
    /* Trim (persisting compacted / folded flags + summary) and return adapter messages that fit. */
    /* opts.summarize(foldedRows, rowLines) -> model summary text or null (only called when folding; see AgentCore) */
    build: function(conv, systemPrompt, model, maxOut, winOverride, opts) {
        opts = opts || {};
        var wi = ContextStore.windowInfo(model, winOverride || gs.getProperty('x_gmg_ai.context.window_tokens', '')), win = wi.tokens;
        var cap = ContextStore.historyCap(gs.getProperty('x_gmg_ai.context.history_tokens', ''), win);   // history cap
        var summary = conv.getValue('summary') || '', fixed = ContextStore.estimateTokens(systemPrompt) + ContextStore.estimateTokens(summary) + 2000;   // +2000: tool schemas headroom
        var budget = Math.max(1000, Math.min(cap, Math.floor(win * ContextStore.BUDGET_SHARE) - fixed)), rows = this.rows(conv), p = ContextStore.plan(rows, budget), self = this, info = {window: win, window_source: wi.source, budget_tokens: cap, compacted: p.compact.length, folded: p.fold.length};
        if (p.compact.length) this._flag(p.compact, conv, 'compacted');
        if (p.fold.length) {
            var foldSet = {}; p.fold.forEach(function(s) { foldSet[s] = 1; });
            var folded = rows.filter(function(r) { return foldSet[r.seq]; }), mt = null;
            if (opts.summarize) { try { mt = opts.summarize(folded, ContextStore.foldText(folded).text); } catch (e) { mt = null; } }
            var ft = ContextStore.foldText(folded, mt); info.summary_source = ft.source;
            summary = (summary ? summary + '\n' : '') + ft.text;
            if (summary.length > 8000) summary = '[older summary trimmed]\n' + summary.substring(summary.length - 7900);
            conv.setValue('summary', summary); conv.setValue('summarized_through', Math.max.apply(null, p.fold)); conv.update();
            this._flag(p.fold, conv, 'folded');
        }
        rows = rows.filter(function(r) { return p.fold.indexOf(r.seq) < 0; }).map(function(r) { if (p.compact.indexOf(r.seq) >= 0) r.compacted = true; return r; });
        var f = ContextStore.fit(rows, Math.max(1000, Math.min(cap, Math.floor(win * ContextStore.BUDGET_SHARE) - ContextStore.estimateTokens(systemPrompt) - ContextStore.estimateTokens(summary) - 2000)));
        info.history_tokens = f.tokens; info.dropped_turns = f.dropped_turns;
        return {messages: ContextStore.toAdapter(f.rows), summary: summary, info: info};
    },
    _flag: function(seqs, conv, field) {
        var m = new GlideRecord(this.T_MSG);
        m.addQuery('conversation', conv.getUniqueValue()); m.addQuery('seq', 'IN', seqs.join(',')); m.query();
        while (m.next()) { m.setValue(field, true); m.update(); }
    },
    /* retention job: delete conversations (and their messages) idle longer than x_gmg_ai.context.retention_days (max 5, default 5) */
    purge: function() {
        var days = ContextStore.retentionDays(gs.getProperty(ContextStore.RETENTION_PROP, String(ContextStore.RETENTION_MAX)));
        var cut = new GlideDateTime(); cut.addDaysUTC(-days);
        var c = new GlideRecord(this.T_CONV), n = 0, k = 0;
        c.addQuery('last_activity', '<', cut.getValue()); c.setLimit(2000); c.query();
        while (c.next()) {
            var m = new GlideRecord(this.T_MSG); m.addQuery('conversation', c.getUniqueValue()); m.query();
            while (m.next()) { m.deleteRecord(); k++; }
            c.deleteRecord(); n++;
        }
        gs.info('GMG AI context retention: deleted ' + n + ' conversations / ' + k + ' messages older than ' + days + ' days');
        return {conversations: n, messages: k, days: days};
    },
    type: 'ContextStore'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-19 01:19:18</sys_created_on><sys_id>cb8732452f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3bb</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ContextStore</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Now Pilot" source="x_gmg_ai">1ca6f2812f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3a5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Now Pilot">1ca6f2812f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3a5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_cb8732452f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3bb</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 01:19:18</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_gmg_ai.GMGSeal</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Open-core split step 5: proposal tamper seal (insert-time hash, route gate); open source core</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>GMGSeal</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[// Copyright 2026 GMG Technology LLC
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
var GMGSeal = Class.create();
/* Open source core (open-core split step 5, approver 2026-10-18): the proposal tamper seal. Moved verbatim from ReviewerTools (scoped copy of
 * GMGAIApplierCore's CARD_OPTION_KEYS / reviewCanon / reviewHash / REVIEW_GATE / reviewGate; bodies must stay identical). Paid ReviewerTools
 * aliases these. routeGate() is the core Confirm gate: route 'none' -> insert-time seal must match; route 'reviewer' -> only with GMG Plan &
 * Create installed (its beforeConfirm checks the verdict), else 409; empty/unknown route -> refused. */
/* architecture review gate, scoped copy (the Reviewer never calls the Applier). MUST stay identical to GMGAIApplierCore's
 * CARD_OPTION_KEYS / reviewCanon / reviewHash / REVIEW_GATE / reviewGate (test_review_gate_store checks the bodies match). Used by
 * get_proposal (hash what was read), ActionService.confirm (refuse before any write) and BuildItemService (Accept / Not passed). */
GMGSeal.CARD_OPTION_KEYS = [['spec', 'update_set'], ['spec', 'update_set_auto'], ['spec', 'activate']];
/* architecture review ruling (c): the canonical hash covers EVERY field the Applier reads to decide what it writes: run_as, target_table,
 * target_sys_id, operation, action_type, target_updated_on, summary, diff, current_script and the payload (card options above excluded). Keys are sorted recursively, so key order alone is
 * not an edit. r: a reviewInput object ({payload, action_type, operation, target_table, target_sys_id}) or a bare payload string. */
GMGSeal.REVIEW_HASH_FIELDS = ['action_type', 'operation', 'target_table', 'target_sys_id', 'target_updated_on', 'summary', 'diff', 'current_script'];   // approver (4): what the card SHOWS (summary, diff, current_script) is hashed too; older stored hashes mismatch -> fail closed   // target_updated_on: the Applier's stale-target check reads it
GMGSeal.BOUND_FIELDS = ['bound_table', 'bound_sys_id'];   // open-core split step 7: sealed when present (a current-record proposal)
GMGSeal.sortDeep = function(v) {
    if (Object.prototype.toString.call(v) == '[object Array]') return v.map(GMGSeal.sortDeep);
    if (v && typeof v == 'object') { var o = {}; Object.keys(v).sort().forEach(function(k) { o[k] = GMGSeal.sortDeep(v[k]); }); return o; }
    return v;
};
GMGSeal.reviewInput = function(pa) {
    var o = {payload: String(pa.getValue('payload') || '')};
    GMGSeal.REVIEW_HASH_FIELDS.forEach(function(f) { o[f] = pa.isValidField(f) ? String(pa.getValue(f) || '') : ''; });
    GMGSeal.BOUND_FIELDS.forEach(function(f) { if (pa.isValidField(f) && pa.getValue(f)) o[f] = String(pa.getValue(f)); });   // step 7
    return o;
};
GMGSeal.reviewCanon = function(r, fields) {
    if (r === null || typeof r != 'object') r = {payload: r};
    var raw = String(r.payload == null ? '' : r.payload), p = null; try { p = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { p = null; }
    var obj = !!(p && typeof p == 'object');
    if (obj) GMGSeal.CARD_OPTION_KEYS.forEach(function(k) { var o = p; for (var i = 0; i < k.length - 1; i++) o = o && typeof o == 'object' ? o[k[i]] : null; if (o && typeof o == 'object') delete o[k[k.length - 1]]; });
    var out = {payload: obj ? p : raw, run_as: obj && p.run_as != null ? String(p.run_as) : ''};
    (fields || GMGSeal.REVIEW_HASH_FIELDS).forEach(function(f) { out[f] = String(r[f] == null ? '' : r[f]); });
    GMGSeal.BOUND_FIELDS.forEach(function(f) { if (r[f]) out[f] = String(r[f]); });   // step 7: the binding is sealed too (only when set, so unbound rows keep their hash)
    return JSON.stringify(GMGSeal.sortDeep(out));
};
GMGSeal.reviewHash = function(r, fields) { return String(new GlideDigest().getSHA256Hex(GMGSeal.reviewCanon(r, fields))).toLowerCase(); };
/* Design review: a stored hash in the OLD canon (before summary, diff, current_script were hashed) that still matches the card = out of date,
 * not edited. Still refused (409); only the message differs. Any other mismatch stays 'edited'. */
GMGSeal.REVIEW_GATE = {not_passed: 'The review didn\u2019t pass this change, so it can\u2019t be applied.', edited: 'This change was edited after the Reviewer passed it, so the pass no longer counts. Ask for a new review.', stale: 'This card is out of date and can\u2019t be accepted. Ask for the change again to get a fresh card.'};
/* r: {review_route, review_state, review_verdict, review_hash, payload} -> '' (may apply) or the refusal. Ruling (3), fail closed:
 * only review_route 'none' (set at creation for a proposal never routed to the Reviewer) skips the review; 'reviewer' needs a stored
 * pass on the same payload; an empty or unknown route is refused. Never inferred from build being empty. */
GMGSeal.gateInput = function(pa) {   // the gate's input read off a pending-action GlideRecord: review fields + everything the hash covers
    var o = GMGSeal.reviewInput(pa);
    ['review_route', 'review_state', 'review_verdict', 'review_hash'].forEach(function(f) { o[f] = pa.isValidField(f) ? String(pa.getValue(f) || '') : ''; });
    return o;
};
GMGSeal.reviewGate = function(r) {
    var miss = function() { return String(r.review_hash || '') == GMGSeal.reviewHash(r, GMGSeal.REVIEW_HASH_FIELDS.filter(function(f) { return ['summary', 'diff', 'current_script'].indexOf(f) < 0; })) ? GMGSeal.REVIEW_GATE.stale : GMGSeal.REVIEW_GATE.edited; };   // Design review: old-canon hash that still matches = out of date, not edited (still refused)
    if (!r) return GMGSeal.REVIEW_GATE.not_passed;
    var route = String(r.review_route || '');
    if (route == 'none') return !r.review_hash ? GMGSeal.REVIEW_GATE.edited : String(r.review_hash) != GMGSeal.reviewHash(r) ? miss() : '';   // architecture review (B): route-none cards carry the server's insert-time hash; any content change -> refused (fails closed when missing)
    if (route != 'reviewer') return GMGSeal.REVIEW_GATE.not_passed;
    if (String(r.review_verdict || '') != 'pass' || String(r.review_state || '') != 'passed') return GMGSeal.REVIEW_GATE.not_passed;
    if (!r.review_hash) return GMGSeal.REVIEW_GATE.edited;
    if (String(r.review_hash) != GMGSeal.reviewHash(r)) return miss();
    return '';
};
GMGSeal.hashOf = function(r) { try { return GMGSeal.reviewHash(r); } catch (e) { return ''; } };
GMGSeal.REVIEW_NEEDS_PAID = 'This change needs a Reviewer pass, which needs GMG Plan & Create. Nothing was applied.';
GMGSeal.routeGate = function(r, paidInstalled) {
    if (!r) return GMGSeal.REVIEW_GATE.not_passed;
    if (String(r.review_route || '') == 'reviewer') return paidInstalled ? '' : GMGSeal.REVIEW_NEEDS_PAID;   // paid beforeConfirm runs GMGSeal.reviewGate (verdict + hash)
    return GMGSeal.reviewGate(r);
};
/* the route-none seal above is an unkeyed SHA-256 stored on the pending-action row, so anyone who
 * can write that row can change the payload/target and recompute the hash. The server therefore ALSO keeps the hash in a row only the server
 * writes: an x_gmg_ai_log row (status 'sealed', pending_action, seal_hash), inserted by server code (plain GlideRecord) right after the card is
 * inserted. x_gmg_ai.user cannot create, write or delete x_gmg_ai_log or x_gmg_ai_pending_action (admin-only ACLs). Accept
 * (ActionService.notPassedBlock) requires: recomputed hash of the stored row == review_hash == the newest server seal. Missing, ambiguous or
 * unreadable seal -> refused (fail closed). No key to generate, store, rotate or leak into an update set. */
GMGSeal.SEAL_TABLE = 'x_gmg_ai_log';
GMGSeal.SEAL_STATUS = 'sealed';
GMGSeal.SEAL_NOTE = 'Proposal sealed by the server; Accept checks the card against this hash.';
GMGSeal.storeSeal = function(pa) {   // server path only; returns the seal row sys_id or ''
    var h = String(pa.getValue('review_hash') || ''), id = String(pa.getUniqueValue() || '');
    if (!h || !id) return '';
    var l = new GlideRecord(GMGSeal.SEAL_TABLE);
    l.initialize();
    l.setValue('user', gs.getUserID()); l.setValue('pending_action', id); l.setValue('status', GMGSeal.SEAL_STATUS); l.setValue('seal_hash', h);
    l.setValue('table_name', String(pa.getValue('target_table') || '')); l.setValue('record_sys_id', String(pa.getValue('target_sys_id') || ''));
    l.setValue('response', GMGSeal.SEAL_NOTE);
    return String(l.insert() || '');
};
/* newest server seal of one pending action ('' = none, or two newest rows in the same second disagree) */
GMGSeal.serverSeal = function(id) {
    if (!id) return '';
    var g = new GlideRecord(GMGSeal.SEAL_TABLE);
    g.addQuery('pending_action', id); g.addQuery('status', GMGSeal.SEAL_STATUS); g.orderByDesc('sys_created_on'); g.setLimit(2); g.query();
    if (!g.next()) return '';
    var h = String(g.getValue('seal_hash') || ''), on = String(g.getValue('sys_created_on') || '');
    if (g.next() && String(g.getValue('sys_created_on') || '') == on && String(g.getValue('seal_hash') || '') != h) return '';
    return h;
};
/* '' = the stored row matches the server seal (or the card is not route none: the Reviewer route is GMG Plan & Create's), else the refusal */
GMGSeal.serverSealGate = function(pa) {
    if (String(pa.getValue('review_route') || '') != 'none') return '';
    var h = String(pa.getValue('review_hash') || ''), s = '';
    try { s = GMGSeal.serverSeal(String(pa.getUniqueValue() || '')); } catch (e) { s = ''; }
    return h && s === h ? '' : GMGSeal.REVIEW_GATE.edited;
};
/* insert-time seal for a route-none proposal (every route-none insert uses it) */
GMGSeal.sealRouteNone = function(pa) {
    if (typeof pa.isValidField != 'function' || !pa.isValidField('review_route') || !pa.isValidField('review_hash') || String(pa.getValue('review_route')) != 'none') return;
    pa.setValue('review_hash', GMGSeal.reviewHash(GMGSeal.reviewInput(pa)));
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-19 01:19:20</sys_created_on><sys_id>2f8772452f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e31a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>GMGSeal</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Now Pilot" source="x_gmg_ai">1ca6f2812f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3a5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Now Pilot">1ca6f2812f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3a5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_2f8772452f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e31a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 01:19:20</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>
<record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_gmg_ai.RecordTools</api_name><caller_access /><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Open-core split step 6: current-record write tools bound to the open record (open source core)</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>RecordTools</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>// Copyright 2026 GMG Technology LLC
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
var RecordTools = Class.create();
/* Open-core split step 6 (spec section 4, approvers 2026-10-18): the core write tools, bound to the record open in the panel.
 * propose_current_record_update has NO table or sys_id parameter; the model cannot name a target. propose_journal_entry / propose_resolution
 * are thin presets of it (same pending kind 'record', same card, bound record only). Nothing is written here: the user must Confirm, the
 * insert-time seal (GMGSeal) and the server-only field guard (ReviewWriteGuard) apply, and Confirm re-checks the binding (step 7).
 * Routing by table structure: a table extending sys_metadata -> artifact edit in a GMG AI update set; any other table -> record path.
 * Validation (floor denylist, system fields, field ACLs, script syntax, active=true refused) is ONE definition in global Core
 * (GMGAIApplier.validateFieldWrite / deniedTable), re-run at Confirm. */
RecordTools.NAMES = ['get_current_record', 'propose_current_record_update', 'propose_journal_entry', 'propose_resolution'];
/* get_current_record (2026-10-19): read the bound (open) record in full, as the user. Password fields are never shown. */
RecordTools.isSecret = function(el) { try { return /^password/.test(String(el.getED().getInternalType())); } catch (e) { return false; } };
RecordTools.CUT = 300; RecordTools.CHUNK = 3000;
/* Card scope (2026-10-19): the artifact card showed "scope undefined" because the card had no scope. Shown scope = the record's own
 * application scope (sys_scope.scope; 'global' for global records), read as the user. Display only: the payload and the seal are unchanged. */
RecordTools.scopeOf = function(table, id) {
    try {
        var g = new GlideRecordSecure(table);
        if (!g.get(id) || !g.isValidField('sys_scope')) return '';
        var raw = String(g.getValue('sys_scope') || '');
        if (raw == 'global') return 'global';
        var s = g.sys_scope && g.sys_scope.scope ? String(g.sys_scope.scope) : '';
        return s || String(g.getDisplayValue('sys_scope') || '');
    } catch (e) { return ''; }
};
/* Per turn: bind the target from the page context (unverified browser input) or refuse. Returns {table, sys_id, display} or {error}. */
RecordTools.bind = function(ctx, G) {
    ctx = ctx || {}; G = G || global.GMGAIApplier;
    var t = String(ctx.table || '').trim(), id = String(ctx.sys_id || '').trim();
    if (!t || !id || id == '-1') return {error: 'No saved record is open, so nothing can be changed. Open the record first.'};
    if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,79}$/.test(t) || !/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(id)) return {error: 'The open page is not a record.'};
    var dn = G.deniedTable(t); if (dn) return {error: dn, denied: true};
    var g = new GlideRecordSecure(t);
    if (!(g.isValid() && g.get(id))) return {error: 'The open record was not found or you cannot read it.'};
    return {table: t, sys_id: id, display: String(g.getDisplayValue() || g.getValue('number') || id)};
};
/* Store the binding on the conversation (bound_table / bound_sys_id / bound_at); a navigation re-binds on the next turn. */
RecordTools.store = function(conv, b) {
    if (!conv || typeof conv.isValidField != 'function' || !conv.isValidField('bound_table')) return;
    var t = b && !b.error ? b.table : '', id = b && !b.error ? b.sys_id : '';
    if (String(conv.getValue('bound_table') || '') == t && String(conv.getValue('bound_sys_id') || '') == id) return;
    conv.setValue('bound_table', t); conv.setValue('bound_sys_id', id); conv.setValue('bound_at', t ? new GlideDateTime().getValue() : '');
    conv.update();
};
RecordTools.promptLine = function(b) {
    return b && !b.error ? 'Bound record (the ONLY record the write tools can change): ' + b.table + ' ' + b.sys_id + ' (' + b.display + '). Related records are not editable. Read it with get_current_record (any table, full script bodies via its field parameter) before explaining or proposing a change.'
        : 'No record is bound for writes: ' + (b && b.error || 'no record open') + ' The write tools refuse until a saved record is open.';
};
RecordTools.prototype = {
    initialize: function(ctx, G) { this.ctx = ctx || {}; this.G = G || null; this.proposed = []; },
    _G: function() { return this.G || global.GMGAIApplier; },
    definitions: function() {
        if (this.ctx.acting_user) return [];   // design (C): record writes never run on the bot runner path
        var F = {type: 'object', description: 'field name -> new value (reference fields: sys_id or display value)'};
        return [
            {name: 'get_current_record',
             description: 'READ the record open in the user\'s browser (the bound record), any table, with the user\'s own permissions. No table or sys_id parameter. ' +
                 'Without field: every readable field (long values cut, listed in long_fields). With field: that field in full (e.g. script), in chunks; pass offset=next_offset for more. Read-only.',
             parameters: {type: 'object', properties: {field: {type: 'string', description: 'One field name to read in full, e.g. script'}, offset: {type: 'integer', description: 'Start position for the next chunk'}}}},
            {name: 'propose_current_record_update',
             description: 'PROPOSE changing fields on the record open in the user\'s browser (the bound record). There is no table or sys_id parameter: only the open record can be changed. ' +
                 'Optional journal entry (work_notes by default; comments are CUSTOMER-VISIBLE, only when asked). Nothing is written until the user Accepts the card. System fields, number and active=true on code are refused.',
             parameters: {type: 'object', properties: {fields: F, journal: {type: 'object', properties: {field: {type: 'string', 'enum': ['work_notes', 'comments']}, text: {type: 'string'}}}, summary: {type: 'string'}}, required: ['summary']}},
            {name: 'propose_journal_entry',
             description: 'PROPOSE a journal entry on the open (bound) record. field: work_notes (DEFAULT) or comments (CUSTOMER-VISIBLE, only when asked). Data write, permanent, applied only after Accept.',
             parameters: {type: 'object', properties: {field: {type: 'string', 'enum': ['work_notes', 'comments']}, text: {type: 'string'}}, required: ['text']}},
            {name: 'propose_resolution',
             description: 'PROPOSE close_code and close_notes on the open (bound) record; resolve: true also sets state Resolved (incident). Applied only after Accept.',
             parameters: {type: 'object', properties: {close_code: {type: 'string'}, close_notes: {type: 'string'}, resolve: {type: 'boolean'}}, required: ['close_code', 'close_notes']}}
        ];
    },
    handles: function(name) { return RecordTools.NAMES.indexOf(name) >= 0; },
    execute: function(name, a) {
        a = a || {};
        if (this.ctx.acting_user) return {error: 'Record writes are not available here.', refused: true};
        var b = this.ctx.bound;
        if (!b || b.error) return {error: (b && b.error) || 'No record is bound.', no_card: true};
        if (name == 'get_current_record') return this.read(a);
        if (name == 'propose_journal_entry') return this.propose({journal: {field: a.field || 'work_notes', text: a.text}, summary: (a.field == 'comments' ? 'Comment' : 'Work note') + ' on ' + b.display});
        if (name == 'propose_resolution') {
            var f = {close_code: a.close_code, close_notes: a.close_notes};
            if (a.resolve === true || a.resolve === 'true') { if (b.table != 'incident') return {error: 'resolve:true is only supported on incident', no_card: true}; f.state = '6'; }
            return this.propose({fields: f, summary: 'Resolution on ' + b.display});

    },
    read: function(a) {
        var b = this.ctx.bound, g = new GlideRecordSecure(b.table);

        var el, n, f;
        if (a.field) {
            f = String(a.field).trim();

            var full = el.getValue() == null ? '' : String(el.getValue()), off = Math.max(0, parseInt(a.offset, 10) || 0), end = off + RecordTools.CHUNK;
            return {table: b.table, sys_id: b.sys_id, field: f, length: full.length, offset: off, value: full.substring(off, end), next_offset: end < full.length ? end : null};
        }
        var o = {table: String(g.getRecordClassName()), sys_id: b.sys_id, display: b.display}, longs = [], els = g.getElements();
        for (var i = 0; i < els.length; i++) {

            if (!raw && !dv) continue;
            var v = dv || raw;
            if (raw && raw != v && /^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(raw)) v += ' [' + raw + ']';
            if (v.length > RecordTools.CUT) { o[n] = v.substring(0, RecordTools.CUT) + '... [' + v.length + ' chars: call get_current_record with field "' + n + '"]'; longs.push(n); }

    },
    propose: function(a) {
        var wo = typeof ActionService == 'undefined' ? '' : ActionService.writesOff();   // refused before any validation or card
        if (wo) return {error: wo, no_card: true, refused: true, writes_off: true};
        var b = this.ctx.bound, G = this._G();
        var v = G.validateFieldWrite({table: b.table, sys_id: b.sys_id, fields: a.fields || {}, journal: a.journal});
        if (v.error) return {error: v.error, no_card: true, no_access: !!v.no_access};
        var staticWarnings = [];
        if (a.fields && a.fields.script && typeof DevValidator != 'undefined') {

                    staticWarnings.push('Static Analysis: ' + sVal.summary);
                    sVal.findings.forEach(function(f) {
                        if (f.severity == 'Critical' || f.severity == 'High') {

                        }

                }
            } catch (eV) {}
        }
        var meta = !!v.metadata, summary = String(a.summary || ('Update ' + v.display)).substring(0, 70);
        var warn = meta ? 'Captured in a GMG AI update set.' : 'Data write: nothing changes until you Accept. On Accept it is written straight to the record, not captured in an update set, so it cannot be backed out.' + (v.journal ? ' A journal entry cannot be edited or removed afterwards.' : '');   // wording (no "applied directly": Confirm is required)
        var live = meta ? G.activeNote(v.active) : '';   // step 8: live-change warning on active code (inactive note otherwise)
        if (live) warn = live + ' ' + warn;
        if (staticWarnings.length) warn = staticWarnings.join('\n') + '\n' + warn;
        var payload = meta ? {op: 'update', table: v.table, sys_id: v.sys_id, fields: v.fields, scope: '', bound: true, active_at_propose: v.active}
                           : {kind: 'record', rec: 'fields', table: v.table, op: 'update', scope: 'global', spec: {table: v.table, sys_id: v.sys_id, fields: v.fields, journal: v.journal || null}, updated_on: v.updated_on, bound: true};
        payload.stamp = {updated_on: String(v.updated_on || ''), mod_count: String(v.mod_count == null ? '' : v.mod_count)};   // AC-F26 stale check at Confirm
        if (v.elevated_note) warn = v.elevated_note + ' Confirm is still required and your record and field ACLs still apply. ' + warn;   // step 9
        var lines = [summary].concat(v.diff).concat(['NOTE: ' + warn]);
        var pa = new GlideRecord('x_gmg_ai_pending_action');
        pa.initialize();
        pa.setValue('user', gs.getUserID()); pa.setValue('action_type', meta ? 'artifact_update' : 'record_fields'); pa.setValue('operation', 'update');
        pa.setValue('target_table', v.table); pa.setValue('target_sys_id', v.sys_id); pa.setValue('target_scope', 'global'); pa.setValue('summary', summary);
        if (pa.isValidField('bound_table')) { pa.setValue('bound_table', b.table); pa.setValue('bound_sys_id', b.sys_id); }
        if (pa.isValidField('target_updated_on')) pa.setValue('target_updated_on', v.updated_on);
        if (pa.isValidField('review_route')) pa.setValue('review_route', 'none');
        pa.setValue('payload', JSON.stringify(payload)); pa.setValue('diff', lines.join('\n')); pa.setValue('status', 'pending');
        var exp = new GlideDateTime(); exp.addSeconds(30 * 60); pa.setValue('expires', exp.getValue());
        pa.setValue('page_url', String(this.ctx.url || '').substring(0, 1000)); if (pa.isValidField('conversation_id')) pa.setValue('conversation_id', String(this.ctx.conversation_id || ''));
        if (typeof GMGSeal != 'undefined') GMGSeal.sealRouteNone(pa);   // core insert-time seal
        var id = typeof ReviewWriteGuard == 'undefined' ? pa.insert() : ReviewWriteGuard.run(function() { return pa.insert(); });
        if (!id) return {error: 'Could not save the proposal.', no_card: true};
        if (typeof GMGSeal != 'undefined' && !GMGSeal.storeSeal(pa)) return {error: 'Could not seal the proposal, so it was not offered. Nothing was written.', no_card: true};   // server-only seal
        var usName = '';   // the GMG AI update set Accept will create, named by the same builder as the Applier ('update <table>' = p.op + ' ' + p.table)
        if (meta && typeof G.updateSetNameFor == 'function') { try { usName = String(G.updateSetNameFor(pa, 'update ' + v.table, id).name || ''); } catch (eu) { usName = ''; } }
        this.proposed.push({id: id, type: meta ? 'artifact' : 'record', rec: 'fields', operation: 'update', table: v.table, target: v.display, record: v.number || v.display,
            record_link: '/' + v.table + '.do?sys_id=' + v.sys_id, scope: meta ? RecordTools.scopeOf(v.table, v.sys_id) : '', bound: true, summary: summary, fields: v.fields, before: v.before, diff_lines: v.diff,
            update_set: usName, update_set_new: !!usName, data_warning: meta ? (v.elevated_note ? v.elevated_note + ' ' : '') + live : warn, elevated_note: v.elevated_note || '', live_warning: v.active == 'true' ? live : '', active: v.active, expires: exp.getDisplayValue(), expires_ms: exp.getNumericValue(), status: 'pending'});

            message: 'Proposal saved. NOTHING HAS BEEN WRITTEN YET. The user must click Accept on the card within 30 minutes.'};
    },
    type: 'RecordTools'
};
</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-19 01:19:21</sys_created_on><sys_id>bf87fe052f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3ec</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>RecordTools</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Now Pilot" source="x_gmg_ai">1ca6f2812f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3a5</sys_package><sys_policy /><sys_scope display_value="Now Pilot">1ca6f2812f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3a5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_bf87fe052f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3ec</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 01:19:21</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_gmg_ai.GMGExtensions</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Open-core split: wrapper over the x_gmg_ai.GMGExtension scripted extension point (no callers yet)</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>GMGExtensions</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[// Copyright 2026 GMG Technology LLC
// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
// GMGExtensions: the only open source core code that touches the x_gmg_ai.GMGExtension scripted extension point (open-core split spec 2.1).
// With no paid app installed, getExtensions returns [] and every hook is a no-op. A throwing extension is logged and skipped;
// callers that gate writes use blocked() so a throwing beforeConfirm counts as a block (fail closed, spec 2.2).
var GMGExtensions = Class.create();
GMGExtensions.POINT = 'x_gmg_ai.GMGExtension';
GMGExtensions.API_VERSION = 1;
GMGExtensions._cache = null;
GMGExtensions._valid = function(x) {
    try { return !!(x && typeof x.id == 'function' && typeof x.apiVersion == 'function' && x.apiVersion() == GMGExtensions.API_VERSION); }
    catch (e) { return false; }
};
GMGExtensions.all = function() {
    if (GMGExtensions._cache) return GMGExtensions._cache;
    var raw = [], out = [], i;
    try { raw = new GlideScriptedExtensionPoint().getExtensions(GMGExtensions.POINT) || []; }
    catch (e) { gs.warn('GMG AI: extension load failed: ' + e); raw = []; }
    for (i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
        if (GMGExtensions._valid(raw[i])) out.push(raw[i]);
        else gs.warn('GMG AI: extension ignored (no id() or apiVersion() != ' + GMGExtensions.API_VERSION + ')');
    }
    GMGExtensions._cache = out;
    return out;
};
GMGExtensions._name = function(x) { try { return String(x.id()); } catch (e) { return '?'; } };
GMGExtensions.call = function(hook, args, fallback) {
    var all = GMGExtensions.all(), res = [], i, x, r;
    for (i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
        x = all[i];
        if (typeof x[hook] != 'function') continue;
        try { r = x[hook].apply(x, args || []); if (r !== undefined && r !== null) res.push(r); }
        catch (e) { gs.warn('GMG AI: extension ' + GMGExtensions._name(x) + '.' + hook + ' threw: ' + e); }
    }
    return res.length ? res : (fallback || []);
};
// beforeConfirm gate: returns null to proceed, or the first {ok:false, code, error} block. A throw is a block.
GMGExtensions.blocked = function(hook, args) {
    var all = GMGExtensions.all(), i, x, r;
    for (i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
        x = all[i];
        if (typeof x[hook] != 'function') continue;
        try { r = x[hook].apply(x, args || []); }
        catch (e) { gs.warn('GMG AI: extension ' + GMGExtensions._name(x) + '.' + hook + ' threw: ' + e); return {ok: false, code: 409, error: 'Extension check failed'}; }
        if (r && r.ok === false) return r;
    }
    return null;
};
GMGExtensions.installed = function() { return GMGExtensions.all().length > 0; };
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-19 01:19:23</sys_created_on><sys_id>149772452f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e397</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>GMGExtensions</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Now Pilot" source="x_gmg_ai">1ca6f2812f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3a5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Now Pilot">1ca6f2812f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e3a5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_149772452f8c1710fe5019aa6fa4e397</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-19 01:19:23</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
